verdict: Organic signals are active across all three locations; no paid leads this period.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, paid advertising was inactive for the full 28 days — no spend, no leads generated through Meta or Google Ads at any location. All engagement came from Google Business Profile and organic search, which combined delivered 387 GBP actions and meaningful local intent signals, particularly at O'Hare Precision. That said, GBP actions softened week-over-week at all three locations, and the trend is sharpest at Advance Grinding, where profile actions fell 55% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7. Paid campaigns are being brought back online to capture the organic demand that currently has no conversion path. Next period, the expectation is a return of measurable lead volume once paid activity resumes.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and website clicks
GBP actions at O'Hare Precision alone this period, the strongest organic footprint of the three locations
week-over-week drop in GBP actions at Advance Grinding, the sharpest local visibility decline across the group

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining across all locations — most sharply at Advance Grinding — with no active paid campaigns to offset the drop or convert existing search demand into leads.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaigns are being reactivated to capture local intent that is currently going unaddressed; website tracking is also being repaired at Forte Metals so organic traffic can be measured accurately going forward.
